name: 3D Converter
description: 3D Converter helps you inspect, convert, and validate 3D models online for 3D printing, game development, and web projects. Work with formats such as STL, OBJ, PLY, GLB, and glTF, preview your model, and compare input and output statistics before downloading. Supported browser-local conversions are free, require no sign-in, and keep your files on your device. Each conversion route explains what the target format can preserve and what may change or be lost, including materials, textures, and animation where applicable. Move models between tools with a clearer view of the result, not just a different file extension.

name: Go-To Local
description: AI employees for local businesses: an AI Front Desk that answers calls and takes messages, and an AI Sales Agent that finds new regular accounts. Colorado, North Carolina and South Carolina. From $249 a month, no setup fee. Founding price $249 a month with the first 30 days free; standard $349.

name: Forager
description: Forager is a B2B data API for people, companies and jobs, covering 800M+ people and 65M+ companies, by API or data feed. One credit balance covers mobile numbers, personal and work emails, person and company enrichment, people search, reverse email lookup and job postings data, plus a prospecting web app. Built for sales tech platforms, recruiting and talent sourcing, data providers and feed buyers, AI agents and developer tools, and agencies. Active profiles are refreshed every 30 days, contact lookups are charged only when a result is found, and nothing found costs 0 credits. Start free with test credits, no credit card. Paid plans start at $45/mo billed yearly. Enterprise: custom annual agreements. Integrates with Clay, Deepline, Cargo, Zapier, Snowflake, Databricks and Amazon S3. Platforms and teams including Clay, Juicebox, Nooks, HubSpot, Andela, SeekOut and Amplemarket run on Forager.

name: MenuCapture
description: MenuCapture is an AI menu photo editor for restaurant owners and chefs. Upload a phone photo of your real dish, type the change in plain words ("add crispy bacon", "brighten it with natural window light", "set it on a red checkered tablecloth"), and get an edited photo in about 15 seconds. It edits the photo of your actual dish; it does not generate dishes from scratch. Every edit is saved as a new version, so you can step back to any earlier one and your original is never touched. You can swap ingredients, change backgrounds and surfaces, fix lighting and color, batch up to 10 photos at once, and export each photo at the sizes DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub and Instagram ask for. Edited photos can go on a free hosted web menu with its own link and QR code. Agencies and web designers can edit client photos from one dashboard or use the API. Free tools need no account: Menu Photo Analyzer, Food Background Generator, Steam Generator, Photo Requirements Checker and more. Pricing: $19/month or $159/year, 300 photo edits a month on both plans. First edit free after signup, no card needed.

name: Ecom Circles
description: Ecom Circles unifies the tools Amazon and Walmart sellers usually buy separately. A sourcing scanner runs whole wholesale or online-arbitrage lists in minutes and flags profit and gating. A rules-based repricer competes for the Buy Box on your terms. Inventory, order management, and 3PL fulfillment live in the same dashboard, with Shopify, BigCommerce, and Mirakl supported. 14-day free trial, plans from $27/mo.

name: Gigaverse
description: Gigaverse AI is a retirement and tax app for gig and 1099 workers: quarterly tax estimates, auto-save, and a portable Roth IRA, Solo 401(k) and SEP IRA (coming soon). Live on Android. Free plan $0, Pro $4.99/mo, Wealth Builder $9.99/mo.

name: Gopost
description: GoPost helps you repurpose content and publish everywhere with just one click. We make it easy to repurpose and post videos across platforms like YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Facebook — all from one place.  Our website: https://gopost.io/

name: Reseller Fee Checker
description: Most reseller spreadsheets mispredict payouts, because every platform charges on a different base. The Reseller Fee Checker runs a resale through eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Whatnot, Depop, Etsy and Vinted the way each platform actually charges — every fee on its true base — and shows the real payout to the cent. Free to use, with no signup.

name: Cloud Castly
description: Cloud Castly turns any TV browser into a screen for sharing. Open cloudcastly.com on the TV, scan the QR code with your phone, and choose what appears. No TV app, extra box, or account needed. Show art and photo slideshows, calm clocks, split-flap message boards, birthday celebrations, collaborative drawing, quiz games, and party reactions. Your phone is the remote, and guests can join games and reactions by QR. Save your TVs with an optional account.

name: Boredom Buster
description: A pass-the-phone party game pack for road trips, couches and hangouts. Hard Disagree: silly debate prompts like "soup is round" where everyone picks a side. Plus timed Trivia, Charades, an Acting Challenge, Would You Rather and Icebreakers. 3,700+ cards. Free on iPhone and Android, and there is a TikTok version you can play right inside TikTok with no install: https://www.tiktok.com/minis/QEW6IpcKllj Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.stratione.boredombuster

name: SMTasker
description: SMTasker is social media automation software for agencies, creators, and businesses. Its browser dashboard manages accounts, content, schedules, limits, and activity logs, while a Windows or Mac client runs supported actions on connected Android devices. Tools cover publishing and engagement across Instagram, TikTok, Threads, Reddit, Snapchat, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, and X; available actions vary by platform. Skye, the built-in AI manager, helps prepare settings, investigate activity, and create reports. Compatible external AI assistants can connect through MCP with configurable permissions. Plans start at $19/month for one device, with a five-day free trial. Skye uses the customer's OpenAI or Anthropic API key; AI usage is billed separately.

name: Viewcat
description: Viewcat is an AI-native video editor for creators. Describe the edit in one sentence and Viewcat cuts the footage, adds captions and builds motion graphics on a real timeline. Then click any title, caption or clip to fix just that part, or edit it by hand. Every AI change is one undo. Pro editing skills and styles are built in: clean up a talking-head take, turn a long video into Shorts with hook titles, recreate a creator's editing style from one reference video, make animated story shorts and YouTube thumbnails. Use Viewcat AI or connect your own Claude Code or Codex plan. Why I built it: I'm Abresham (Creator Abe). I've edited videos since childhood and now make content full-time for more than 150,000 followers, while studying Mechatronics and Robotics Engineering in Canada. Editors charge around $20 a Reel, and AI tools either hand you a result you can't fix or make you re-prompt forever. Viewcat is the editor I wanted: AI does the first pass in minutes, and you keep full manual control. Available for Windows and Apple Silicon Macs. The manual editor is free forever with no export watermark; AI plans start at $20/month.

name: Fluxo: Learn & Remember
description: Fluxo is a notes app that also helps you remember what you write down. Save a lecture, a chapter, a new word or a thought from a podcast, and Fluxo will bring it back later as a quick quiz, a few flashcards or a short summary. LEARN WHAT YOU'RE INTO Give every topic its own Space: English, marketing, psychology, whatever you're learning Keep notes inside each Space and group them into folders Decide how much time each Space gets per week CAPTURE IT YOUR WAY Write notes in a clean, simple editor Record your voice, and Fluxo turns it into text Import files, including PDFs, and keep them next to your notes AI sorts each note into the right Space, or creates a new one when nothing fits Everything ends up in one place, ready for review PRACTICE THAT ACTUALLY WORKS Your notes turn into quizzes, flashcards or short summaries with the key points AI looks at each note and suggests the practice that will help you remember it best Prefer something else? Switch the format in one tap REVIEWS AND REMINDERS THAT FIT YOUR WEEK Fluxo uses spaced repetition, so each note comes back just before it starts to fade The better you know something, the less often you'll see it Choose your days and time, and Fluxo only pings you when there's something to review Tap the reminder and you're straight into practice MEET FLUXO A little companion who reminds you to practice and notices when you do Keep your streak going, even with five minutes a day FLUXO BOOST Unlimited Spaces (the free plan has 3) More AI help and more detailed progress stats

name: Solitaire Online
description: Solitaire Online is a modern, fast, and completely distraction-free Klondike Solitaire card game designed for web browsers. It features classic Turn 1 and Turn 3 modes, smooth drag-and-drop card animations, undo history, and detailed game statistics. 100% free with no intrusive ads or downloads required.

name: Adbolish
description: AdBolish stops ads, trackers and malware at the DNS level, so they never load in Chrome, Edge, Windows, Office, games or anything else on your PC. It runs on your machine, never records what you browse, and it's free. A browser extension only sees the browser. Windows, Office, chat apps, games and smart-TV-style apps all phone home too. AdBolish sits where every one of them asks for an address, so one blocker covers them all. Protection runs quietly from the tray. When you want to see what it's doing, or a site needs a hand, everything is one click away.

name: PRO COACH
description: PRO COACH is a complete coaching business system for personal trainers and online fitness coaches. Manage clients, build custom training programs, track progress, organise check-ins, store resources, and run your coaching business from one flexible workspace. Designed to replace messy spreadsheets and expensive monthly software, PRO COACH gives coaches more control, better organisation, and lifetime access without ongoing subscription fees. Click here to read reviews from our 1,500+ coaches

name: Mobeera Office
description: Mobeera Office: Docs, Sheets, Slides and PDF for Mac, iPhone and iPad. Pay once and keep it for life. Download it on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mobeera-office/id6785192468 Give your AI an office Turn notes into a client proposal, build a financial model with real formulas, prepare an investor deck, or fill in and redact a PDF. On Mac, one AI agent can carry a job across all four editors. Open and save Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files. Review the work before you use it Your AI previews pages and checks the layout as it works. In Docs, its edits appear as tracked changes under its name, so you accept or reject each one. The finished files are yours to approve. Bring your own AI Use AI Chat in any document with your own API key from Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter, or with a local model. On Mac, you can also let Claude, ChatGPT and other AI apps work in your files through MCP. Your AI provider bills you directly for its usage. Pay once. No subscription. One purchase covers every Mac, iPhone and iPad signed in to your Apple account, with no device limit and nothing to renew or cancel. The Mac app needs Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later. Early customer offer Lifetime access is US$9.99 in launch week, then rises each Thursday: US$19.99, US$29.99, US$39.99 and US$49.99 in weeks 2 to 5. From week 6 it is US$99, still paid once. Whichever week you buy, you get the same lifetime access. Prices in other countries: https://mobeera.io/pricing Watch Meet Mobeera Office: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GAcDSY2DrGE Every AI agent needs an office: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3proWVo2dBE Copilot vs Mobeera Office + MCP: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LHiToXbfQ4U Features: • Bring AI to documents: You can use AI to help write and edit documents. • Create proposals and models: Easily make client proposals and financial models. • Work with different file types: Open and save Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files. • Preview changes: You can see edits made by AI and decide to keep or reject them. • One-time payment: Pay once and use it on all your Apple devices without subscriptions. • Use your own AI: Connect your own AI from various providers to assist in documents. • Compatible with Apple silicon: Works on newer Macs with Apple silicon and the latest macOS.

name: Image4
description: Image4 (https://image4.app) is an AI image generator and photo editor for creators, marketers, designers, and artists. Write a prompt or upload a reference image to create marketing visuals, portraits, illustrations, product shots, and social artwork, then review and refine the draft in the same workspace. Choose from models such as GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro, and Nano Banana 2, and control aspect ratio, resolution, and quality. The site also supports image editing, character consistency, multiple output sizes, background removal, and upscaling. A commercial license is included with all plans, and paid outputs are watermark-free. You can start without a credit card. Image4 offers a free plan with daily credits, a signup credit gift, and paid Basic, Pro, and Max subscriptions that save 50% with annual billing, plus one-time credit packs for extra volume. Monthly subscription credits refresh each billing cycle. Open Image4, turn a prompt into a finished AI image, and add credits only when you need more volume.

name: Reviato
description: Reviato is customer feedback and review analysis software for restaurants, hotels, vacation rentals and other local businesses. Owners and managers can collect private feedback through a QR code or link, follow up when customers consent, and explore recurring praise and complaints in public reviews. Private messages arrive in a team inbox with ratings, optional contact details, assignment and follow-up status. Connected Google Maps, Tripadvisor, Booking.com or Airbnb reviews are searchable, with sentiment, topics, highlighted comments and trends that keep the original source visible.

name: PinnFeed
description: PinnFeed is a self-serve API for real-time Pinnacle odds: WebSocket stream of normalized deltas plus REST, no-vig fair odds, closing-line history, 13 sports. Hosted MCP server for ChatGPT and Claude. Free REST plan; Builder (€99/mo) is the WebSocket plan. Paid plans include a 3-day free trial (card required).

name: ParamDesk
description: ParamDesk is a small campaign-link builder for solo operators who post on more than one channel. Pick a platform preset (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Reddit, Email) and ParamDesk builds a clean URL with standard UTM fields. It applies naming rules automatically (lowercase, hyphens, no stray spaces), so your analytics stop splitting “TikTok”, “tiktok” and “tik-tok” into three sources. Every link is saved to a searchable library with CSV export. Honest status: ParamDesk isn’t built yet. This is a demand test. If enough people join the waitlist, we build it. If not, the project stops.

name: Synero
description: Synero sends one question to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok at the same time. You get one combined answer, plus a clear look at where the models agree and where they split. Try 3 free questions with no card, then it's $10 a month with $10 of usage included, or buy $5, $10 or $25 credit packs.

name: Inplain
description: Inplain turns AI chats, files and data into editable reports, decks and dashboards you share as live links, with Office and PDF export.

name: Bicep Heart AI
description: Turn one photo into a 7-second 9:16 bicep heart clip: smile, flex, hands folded into a heart. Upload one photo of one adult person, tick the two consent boxes, and get an MP4 of them doing the move, usually in a few minutes. Pay per use: 1 clip $4.99, 3 clips $9.99, 8 clips $19.99, one-time payment, credits never expire. Failed clips are refunded automatically and uploaded photos are deleted after about two days.

name: Capsulla
description: Capsulla is a browser DLP for companies that use Google Workspace . It runs in Google Chrome and checks text entered into websites, as well as file uploads and downloads. Text detection happens locally in the browser. File checks rely on MIME types and filename extensions, not file contents. Text detection: Capsulla checks copied, pasted and typed text in Chrome. Built-in detection patterns cover payment card numbers, IBANs, credentials and security keys. Custom patterns cover company-specific formats, such as customer IDs and internal ticket numbers. File type restrictions: Capsulla checks file uploads and downloads by MIME type and filename extension. Files that match a blocked type or extension cannot be transferred through the browser. Rule actions: Copy rules can block, mask, warn or log. Paste rules can block, warn or log. Typing rules can warn or log. File rules block matching transfers. Custom detection patterns: Generate with AI creates a detection pattern from a plain-language description. The proposed pattern can be reviewed before it becomes part of the company's policy. Admin console: The web console contains detection policies, browser status and audit logs. Each recorded event shows the matched rule, action, website, work account and time. Audit logs can be filtered and exported. Email alerts are also available. Local detection: Text checks run on the computer inside Chrome. Capsulla receives event details, but never the matching text, clipboard contents or file contents. Deployment and pricing: The Chrome extension is deployed through Google Admin and can be force-installed for selected teams or the entire company. It requires no individual employee setup. The subscription costs $139 per month for the whole company, with no per-seat fees. A 14-day free trial is available without a credit card. Capsulla covers managed desktop Chrome on Windows, macOS and Linux. Its checks apply to text and file transfers on websites.

name: All in Term
description: All in Term is a powerful, all-in-one terminal and server management application built for macOS. Designed for developers, DevOps engineers, and system administrators, it brings essential infrastructure tools together in one modern, intuitive workspace. Stop switching between multiple applications for SSH, SFTP, databases, Docker, and server monitoring. All in Term puts everything you need in one place. Key Features Terminal & SSH: Manage local terminals and remote SSH connections with password or private key authentication, multiple tabs, and saved commands. SFTP File Manager: Browse, upload, download, and edit remote files directly within the application. Database Management: Connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB, explore tables, execute SQL queries, and inspect data. Docker Management: Monitor containers, inspect logs, and explore Docker Compose configurations. Nginx Tools: Manage configurations, analyze traffic, and investigate access and error logs. Redis Management: Browse keys, inspect values, and manage expiration settings. Server Monitoring: Track CPU, memory, disk usage, processes, and network activity. System Care: Review server health, identify maintenance opportunities, and inspect security settings. Why All in Term? All in Term simplifies complex infrastructure workflows by combining terminal access, file transfers, database operations, and server administration into a single streamlined experience. Whether you're managing production servers, debugging applications, or maintaining infrastructure, All in Term helps you work faster and stay organized.

name: LookRecipe
description: LookRecipe turns any web image into an editable AI prompt covering lighting, composition, color and lens, then can recreate the look with your own photo. Hover to analyze or drag-select any area, copy the prompt to Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux or ChatGPT. Local collecting is free with no account; one-time credit packs from $4.99, no subscription.

name: Lipcue
description: Lipcue is a real-time AI interview copilot and voice mock-interview tool for Windows 10 and 11. It listens to your live interview, detects questions instantly, and projects tailor-made answers from your own resume and notes on an invisible HUD. Includes voice mock interviews, a free STAR answer generator, and company dossiers. Free plan plus Pro at US$19/month or US$168/year.

name: apicrux
description: Describe what you want to automate in plain English. With 10,000+ connectors and our universal REST engine, apicrux connects to practically anything with an API—including your vibe-coded apps, Next.js backends, or on-premises tools. Run entire batch migrations in 1 single workflow for practically $0

name: DraftVano
description: DraftVano helps DIYers plan timber framing before buying stock. Six project builders accept exact dimensions in millimetres or inches and show a 3D preview, part quantities and stock-board requirements. Inspect a real fixed PDF sample before purchasing a custom PDF export from EUR 9.90. Optional M-04 guidance costs EUR 4.90 extra. A separate free timber cut-list calculator takes your supplied lengths and quantities, stock length, saw kerf and end allowances. It produces a suggested 1D board layout with CSV export, printing and sharing, without an account. Current scope is straight timber lengths and framing plans. The cutting arrangement is a heuristic, not a guaranteed minimum. It does not nest plywood sheets, certify structural safety or supply CNC/DXF files. Physical suitability, joints and appliance requirements need separate checking. The gallery and video show digital previews and actual calculator examples, not customer build evidence. AI-assisted product development and presentation.

name: Nexhang
description: Nexhang is a free platonic hangout app for meeting people. Post a hangout — coffee, a hike, board games — and people nearby or online tap Going and meet up. It has real-time hangouts, events, groups, a forum, and messages. Kansas City first, everyone welcome. No dating, no swiping, plans.

name: BuildWire Calc
description: BuildWire Calc is a phone app of offline trade calculators for people who work on site; they keep working with no signal. Electrical: voltage drop, wire size, breaker size, load, Ohm's law, three-phase power, conduit bending. Construction: concrete slab, footing, rebar, roof pitch, stairs. HVAC: BTU, CFM, duct size, superheat. Save a job and share it as PDF, CSV or text. No ads, no account. Free on iPhone and Android; Pro unlocks the rest. Contact support@buildwirecalc.com.

name: Monolith workbench
description: Monolith Workbench is a desktop application designed to make editing complex, technical, and academic documents feel effortless by bringing publication-quality typesetting directly to a visual canvas. By replacing split-screen code editors with a fluid, real-time workspace, it pairs the straightforward ease of a word processor with the layout power and precision of LaTeX.

name: DiagramSmith
description: DiagramSmith is a diagram maker that runs in your browser, with apps on Android and Windows. Make flowcharts, UML, ER, Gantt, timelines, org charts, mind maps and Venn diagrams; open .drawio and Mermaid files; export PNG, SVG or PDF. No account for free use. Pro adds vector PDF, editable .drawio export and a dead-end check. support@diagramsmith.com

name: Ready SVG
description: Ready SVG is an AI SVG maker for laser engraving, cutting, and everyday design. Describe an idea, upload a PNG or JPG (up to 10 MB), or use both. Choose Laser Engrave (black-filled artwork), Cut (red cut outlines with connection checks), or Normal (full-color SVG). AI redraws references by default before building vector paths; free Optimize prompt improves your text before you generate. Preview the real SVG, set export width in millimeters, and download. Successful results save to private History with free re-export. New accounts get 5 free Credits (plus 5 more on first Chrome extension sign-in). Each successful SVG uses 1 Credit; failed jobs are refunded. Free exports are watermarked; a confirmed subscription or Credit Pack unlocks watermark-free previews and exports. Also available as a Chrome extension that sends any web image into the same Laser Engrave, Cut, and Normal workflow.

name: FrameShot
description: FrameShot is a free Chrome extension that records your screen with sound and a webcam bubble, and captures a full web page in one click. Annotate with arrows and text, blur or redact private details, then export MP4, PNG, GIF or PDF. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account or watermark, and it works offline. Install from the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/frameshot-free-screen-rec/adcgjmghjagflmmndoajdidcopodacac . Made by Unique Labs, developed by Shahriar Ahmed.

name: Diskfern
description: Diskfern was built to solve a frustrating problem that many Mac users face: running out of storage without understanding where their disk space actually goes, or knowing which files are safe to remove. Traditional storage analyzers do a decent job of visualizing disk usage through charts and folder hierarchies. However, visualization alone doesn't solve the real problem. Users can see enormous folders, caches, development artifacts, application leftovers, and system data, but are often left wondering: What is this? Do I need it? Is it safe to delete? That gap became the central problem we wanted to address. Instead of building another cleanup utility that blindly recommends deleting files, I focused on creating a storage intelligence and cleanup experience that helps users understand their Mac before making changes. What I built Diskfern combines deep storage analysis, intelligent categorization, contextual file inspection, and safety-conscious cleanup into one native macOS application. Key capabilities include: • Full-Disk Storage Analysis: Scan and investigate disk usage with detailed Treemap, Sunburst, and List visualizations. • Smart Highlights: Automatically identify storage opportunities across 44 categories, including caches, unused data, developer artifacts, large files, and application leftovers. • Disk Advisor: Explain unfamiliar files and folders in plain language, helping users understand their purpose and potential cleanup implications. • Natural-Language Finder: Find files using everyday queries, such as "videos larger than 1 GB" or "PDFs from this month." • File Inspector: Examine file sizes, paths, permissions, metadata, and previews through Quick Look. • Intelligent Cleanup: Review recommendations, understand risk labels, collect selected files, and move approved items to Trash rather than permanently deleting them. • Application Uninstaller: Remove applications along with their associated leftover files. • Developer Cleanup: Investigate storage consumed by Xcode DerivedData, simulators, node_modules, Docker, Homebrew, Conda, Gradle, and other development environments. Engineering and product philosophy Building a reliable disk utility requires more than identifying large files. Filesystem permissions, protected directories, symbolic links, inaccessible locations, and macOS security restrictions make storage analysis particularly challenging. I focused on native macOS engineering, permission-aware scanning, safe filesystem operations, and predictable cleanup behavior. Privacy was another core consideration: storage analysis is designed around on-device processing rather than uploading users' personal files to external servers. Diskfern supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, with a free scanning experience and lifetime Pro upgrades. The ultimate goal is simple: help Mac users understand their storage, make informed decisions, and reclaim space without blindly deleting things they don't understand.

name: Outlier
description: A free unlimited Krillion game: endless prompts, no daily cap. Name something that fits, and the rarer your answer, the further your UFO flies.

name: AI Rapper
description: AI Rapper turns one photo and a topic into an AI rap video. Type what the rap should be about and read the lyrics free; pick the version you like or edit it, because what you see is what gets rapped. Then the person in your photo raps those bars on a music-video set, with the vocal, the beat and the lip sync made together. A standard video is a 10-second vertical 9:16 MP4. Other effects: diss track, rap battle, birthday rap, rapping pet, two-person duets, Viking rap and history rap. Song-only effects return a full rap, drill, trap or phonk song as MP3 with lyrics. Two tools need no sign-in: a rap lyrics generator and a rap name generator. Pricing is credit packs bought once: 40 credits for $9.90, 100 for $19.90 or 270 for $49. Most videos use 20 credits and a song uses 5. No subscription, and credits do not expire.

name: InGulfJobs
description: InGulfJobs lists verified job vacancies in Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain from licensed recruiters. Every listing shows the agency's licence and permission numbers so candidates can verify the job before applying. Free for job seekers, updated daily.

name: Lumapin
description: Lumapin helps local businesses like shops, clinics, salons, restaurants and service businesses get more calls and customers from Google Maps, Google Search, Instagram, Facebook and AI answers such as ChatGPT and Gemini. Every week it measures how the business shows up, finds the gaps that cost calls (missing listing details, unanswered reviews, quiet weeks), and drafts the fixes: review replies, Google posts, listing updates, social posts and reels. The owner approves each one, or puts safe items like 4 and 5 star review replies on autopilot. A monthly report shows what changed. We never promise rankings; we report measured change. Agencies can manage 10 to 200 locations with white label and client approval links. Start with a free Google Business Profile report, then a 7-day trial with no card. Plans from $9 a month (₹499 in India).

name: MotionShine
description: MotionShine is a free Mac screen recorder with a camera bubble, auto zoom on every click and a smooth cursor. No watermark, no time limit. Record your screen, then edit the same recording in the app: move or delete each zoom, restyle the cursor, change the camera layout, add captions made on your Mac, and export to MP4 or GIF. Free has every feature, with exports up to 720p. Pro is a one-time payment for 1080p up to 4K and 60 fps, no subscription. Runs on macOS 13 and later.

name: Soma
description: Soma reads lab reports on your iPhone: share the PDF from your lab or take a photo of a paper report, check every row, and each marker goes onto a chart against your lab's own range. Results from different labs, in mg/dL or mmol/L, line up on one chart. No account, no ads, no analytics, nothing uploaded to read your reports. Soma organizes your results; it doesn't diagnose or give medical advice. Coming to the App Store soon.

name: LaunchedInk
description: Most directories give your logo a page. This one could give it a place on my arm. LaunchedInk has two parts. The first is The Flash Book, a startup directory for people who want to see what other founders are building and share something of their own. A business gets a page for its logo, what it does and the story behind it. You can browse by category or submit your own startup. For a free listing, add a linked LaunchedInk badge to your site and send your listing for review. The second part is where I got a little carried away. I love tattoos and I love people who build things. So I mapped 55 spaces for business logos on an interactive 3D arm. Turn it around, pick a spot and try your logo in black and grey. It’s a pretty good way to find out if your mark belongs on an outer forearm before either of us gets too attached to the idea. If the campaign hits both targets, I’ll have the sleeve tattooed on my arm. That means at least 30 confirmed paid placements and £6,000 in sleeve sales by 31 May 2027. If either target is missed, sleeve buyers get a full refund. A directory listing is separate from a sleeve placement, so you can join The Flash Book without having to explain to anyone why your logo is on my elbow. Come find a startup you hadn’t heard of yesterday. Put your own in the book. And if your logo looks particularly good in ink, you know where to find my arm.

name: Sellerverse
description: All-in-one ERP for Amazon sellers. Forecast, purchase orders, suppliers, inventory, ads, reimbursements and real profit per order — in one connected platform. Pricing: Starter $249/mo, Growth $549/mo, Enterprise $1,500+/mo. 14-day free trial. Try the demo: https://app.sellerverse.ai/demo Founded by Raza Ul Mustafa, CEO & Founder. Sellerverse launched 23 October 2026. Contact: contact@sellerverse.ai | +1 (425) 494-1582 | 6825 176th Ave NE, Suite 135-A, Redmond, WA 98052, US.

name: Regulus Business
description: A storefront link for African sellers: products, prices, photos in one place — orders and bookings land on WhatsApp, already structured. Free to start.

name: Credentialing Check
description: Credentialing Check gives healthcare staffing agencies one place to track licenses, certifications, expirations, missing documents, and clinician readiness. Automatic expiration reminders, per-clinician compliance checklists, and a read-only client portal for hospitals — starting free for up to 5 clinicians, live in minutes, no enterprise contract. Features: license and certification tracking (all 50 states); automated expiration reminders (60/30/14/7/3/1 days); per-clinician compliance checklist and live compliance score; secure document storage; verification tracking and audit trail (who / how / when); clinician self-service upload portal; read-only client portal for hospitals; expiration calendar; reports with CSV/PDF export; AI credential auto-fill (Agency plan). Starts Free — Free $0/month up to 5 clinicians; Starter $49.99/month up to 50; Pro $149.99/month up to 250; Agency $299.99/month up to 1,000; Enterprise custom. Based in Boca Raton, FL, USA. Note: Credentialing Check tracks and manages credentials your team verifies; it does not perform primary source verification.

name: Skepsis
description: Skepsis is a free, open-source game that teaches the Greek roots, myths and big ideas hiding in everyday English, in 3-minute lessons. Why Greek? When you know what words really mean, you use language more precisely and think in a more structured way. Democracy is people + power, hubris is the overreach before the fall, and ethos, pathos and logos are the three ways people try to persuade you. That helps you notice when language is being used on you, and tell good from bad. I'm trying to help Texans learn Greek, so every word comes with a Texas example (rodeo is Spanish, but squirrel is secretly Greek). 33 short lessons and 93 roots and ideas, with guess-first questions, spaced review and a speed round called Rodeo. No account, no ads, MIT licensed: https://github.com/ionpetro/skepsis

name: Competitor Teardown Pack
description: A $19 pack of detailed competitor teardowns for SaaS founders. Each one breaks down a real product's homepage messaging, pricing page, onboarding flow and positioning, with what to copy and what to avoid. Instant PDF download.

name: GMXS
description: GMXS is a free URL shortener by Gamix Labs. Turn a long URL into a short link you can share in a message, social post, or newsletter. Shorten up to 10 links a day without an account. A free account lets you organize your links, choose custom aliases, change destinations, pause links, and set expiry dates. The private dashboard shows click counts without storing visitor IP addresses for analytics.

name: FacetQuiz
description: FacetQuiz is a free picture quiz where you pick the faces you are drawn to and get a type card with counts. It uses fictional AI portraits and needs no sign-up. The site also offers a face shape finder and a face symmetry test.

name: UPC Label Maker
description: UPC Label Maker is a browser tool for small e-commerce and Amazon FBA sellers who need barcode labels that scan. Type or paste a UPC-A, EAN-13, Amazon FNSKU (X00...) or GS1 DataMatrix code and the check digit is computed for you. Download a single label free as a 600 DPI PNG or SVG, or sign up to print full sheets: 30-up Avery 5160 / 8160, 10-up Avery 5163, 2 x 1 inch thermal rolls and 4 x 6 inch carton labels, with several products mixed on one sheet from a CSV. Other free tools: an Amazon 30-up PDF to thermal roll converter, a bulk barcode generator that returns a ZIP of PNG or SVG files, a UPC/EAN check digit calculator, and blank Avery PDF and Word templates. It does not sell or issue GS1 UPC numbers.

name: Toolscase AI
description: Toolscase AI helps you choose the right AI model for every task instead of relying on one model for everything. Describe what you want to accomplish, and the platform evaluates the task's requirements, compares suitable AI models, and recommends an option based on capability, quality, speed, and budget. Find the Right Model for the Job Whether you're debugging code, analyzing a large PDF, writing SEO content, researching competitors, or building software, Toolscase AI helps identify models suited to the work. Recommendations consider factors such as reasoning ability, context size, coding capabilities, and speed. Compare Models Before You Decide Explore the model catalog and compare available options side by side. Understand the relative strengths, limitations, and estimated costs of different models before committing to a particular approach. Understand and Control AI Costs See an estimated cost before running a task and review the actual cost afterward. Cost optimization suggestions help you identify situations where a less expensive model may be sufficient. Run Tasks with a Fallback Option A recommendation does not automatically execute a task. You decide whether to proceed. When an eligible model fails, the platform can fall back to a suitable alternative within your budget and report which model handled the task. Built for Developers and Teams Toolscase AI supports a range of AI providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, xAI, Meta, and Mistral. Paid plans add features such as bringing your own API keys, usage and cost analytics, team controls, spending limits, and API access. Start Free Explore AI recommendations with a free plan that includes 50 recommendations and five task runs per month. Upgrade as your requirements grow. Toolscase AI is designed for developers, researchers, content creators, and businesses that want to make more informed AI model choices, compare trade-offs, and manage AI usage costs more effectively.

name: AunuCore
description: AunuCore AI Gateway gives developers one OpenAI-compatible API for 190+ frontier models from leading providers — chat, image, and audio — behind a single API key and a single balance. Switch models by name without changing your integration, watch usage in real time from the dashboard, and extend your apps with built-in MCP tool support and a 311-endpoint REST toolkit. Built and operated by AunuCore Creative Network, an independent creative studio from Indonesia.

name: Pro Cut Out
description: ProCutOut is an all-in-one collection of free online tools for images, PDFs, logos, videos, and text. Our goal is to make everyday creative tasks simple and accessible to everyone. Whether you need to remove an image background, upscale photos, compress files, resize images, edit PDFs, or work with text, ProCutOut brings useful tools together in one place. No account, no signup, and no watermarks. Most tools process files directly in your browser, so your files stay on your device. Selected AI-powered tools make complex tasks easier with just a few clicks. We're continuously adding new tools and improving the experience to make ProCutOut a useful toolbox for creators, students, designers, freelancers, and everyday users. Simple, fast, free, and accessible to everyone.

name: Wholetally
description: Wholetally is cookieless web analytics for agencies and freelancers who manage several client sites. One account and one dashboard cover many sites, EU-hosted, as a practical alternative to Google Analytics. Visits from AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini) are reported separately from AI crawlers. Plans from €7/month (excl. VAT), 30-day free trial with no card. Try the sample-data demo without an account: https://app.wholetally.com/demo

name: Catchr
description: Catchr connects your marketing platforms to the reporting, analysis, AI, and storage tools you already use. Bring data from advertising, analytics, CRM, and ecommerce platforms into Looker Studio, Power BI, Google Sheets, Excel, ChatGPT, and Claude. You can also export data to warehouses and storage destinations such as BigQuery and Amazon S3, or access it through the Catchr API for custom workflows. Built for agencies, freelancers, and marketing teams, Catchr simplifies working with data across multiple channels and client accounts. Connect your sources, select the accounts you need, and choose your destinations. Build recurring client reports, compare campaign performance, monitor advertising spend, and investigate changes in metrics like CPA and ROAS. Create dashboards in your preferred BI tool, run custom analyses in spreadsheets, or ask ChatGPT and Claude questions about your connected marketing data. For more advanced needs, use scheduled exports and API access to feed internal applications, centralize historical data, and support your own reporting infrastructure. With over 100 marketing platforms and more than 20 destinations, Catchr gives teams the flexibility to use the same connected sources across everyday reporting and custom data workflows. Spend less time collecting and moving numbers, and more time turning them into useful analysis and recommendations. FEATURES • Connects Marketing Platforms : links your marketing tools to reporting and analysis tools you already use • Data Export : send your data to storage places like BigQuery and Amazon S3 • Build Reports : create regular reports for clients easily • Compare Campaigns : check how different marketing campaigns are doing against each other • Monitor Spend : keep an eye on how much you're spending on ads • Custom Analysis : run your own analysis in spreadsheets or ask AI tools about your data • Dashboards : make visuals in your favorite dashboard tools • Multiple Sources : works with a lot of marketing platforms and destinations

name: Genjutsu AI
description: Genjutsu AI is an online video tool that recasts existing footage with your reference photos. Upload a source video or pick one from the community library, add the photos you want to use, and generate. A written prompt is optional. Motion Transfer keeps the original movement, timing, and camera while rebuilding the people and visuals from your photos. Object Swap changes one selected person, outfit, product, or object and keeps the rest of the shot as close to the source as possible. You can add one reference photo for each person, up to 10 photos per video.

name: Popijmo
description: Popijmo ("let's have a drink" in Serbian) is a social network that doesn't keep you glued to your screen – it gets you out. Tap "I'm up for a drink!", show up on the live map and see who nearby is in the mood too. Send an invite with one tap, chat, and meet up. You can also find bars and cafés on the map with opening hours and how busy they are, share photos and short videos, follow people and join group chats. Built in Serbia by two friends from the same local bar, Nikola (26) and Siniša (59). In under five months it has grown to more than 4,100 users, mostly across the Balkans. It's not a dating app – it's for company. Free on Android, iPhone and the web, in 32 languages.

name: Topped
description: Topped is for app and SaaS founders and teams who want short-form video to bring users in. Paste your product link and Topped makes posts for your app, modeled on posts that already did well. You approve, edit or pass. Topped publishes what you approve to your own TikTok, Instagram and YouTube accounts, now or on a schedule, and shows what every post got. You can also make your own posts from a large library of hooks, and add a screen recording of your app once so Topped can put it into your posts. Topped works from your own agent too. Connect Claude, ChatGPT or another agent and it can do everything you can do in the app: make posts, edit them, schedule and publish them, and check how they did. Marketing your app can take as little as two minutes a day. Start free, no card needed.

name: DoorFound
description: Maps get guests to the street. The last metres (side door, car-park ramp, the right lift) are where they get stuck. DoorFound turns your way in into one shareable link: parking tips, a photo of the right door, and short steps in walking order. Add it to a booking confirmation, reminder or chat. Visitors open it on their phone, with no app to download and no visitor sign-up. Built for studios, salons, clinics, venues and event hosts. Creating and sharing arrival guides is free.

name: Stripe Fee Calculator
description: FeeSolve is a free Stripe fee calculator for sellers who want processing and payout cuts in the quote before they hit publish.

name: Panel Font
description: Panel Font’s AI manga translator is a browser‑based tool built for manga, manhwa and manhua translation with no software download required. It supports over 100 languages and handles single or bulk uploads of images, PDF and ZIP files. Powered by comic‑optimized AI and advanced OCR, it identifies irregular speech bubbles, erases original text, restores background artwork, and re‑typesets translated dialogue naturally while preserving panel layouts and character speaking tones. It serves casual comic fans, language learners and scanlation teams with flexible credit‑based pricing. Guests get limited daily free credits, while subscription and one‑time credit options cover higher‑volume professional needs. Users simply pick translation models, upload comic files and set language pairs to generate finished translated pages in minutes, removing language barriers for global comic reading and localisation work.

name: IndieBob
description: IndieBob is the growth tool for indie developers and small teams. Bob, its AI advisor, drafts blog posts from your product's facts sheet and flags anything the facts don't support. One post becomes posts for nine platforms, each with its own tracked link. Outreach finds businesses, reads their websites and writes every first email for that one prospect; you approve it before it goes. A small cookieless tracker shows where visitors come from, and the Command Center ranks what to do next across your projects. The free plan is free forever, with no card needed.

name: Worn In
description: Worn In tracks the distance on each pair of running and walking shoes using workouts already saved in Apple Health. Choose a default pair for each activity and new workouts update it automatically. Review older matches before assigning them, including overlaps between pairs. Adjust each pair's expected lifespan and see what remains in Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. Lifespan is an estimate, not a measurement of shoe condition. Track all your shoes for free without a time limit, match the last 30 days of workouts and new ones, and sync your shoe library through private iCloud. Optional yearly Pro adds earlier history, statistics, cross-brand sizing and wear reminders. No Worn In account, ads or analytics. Requires an iPhone with iOS 27 or later. The app supports 11 languages.
